robert

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: How to Paste Stuff Across Several Facets?
parts:
This isn't pertaining your annotation problem. Do you really need boxplots to show the data at hand? I was faced with a similar problem just recently and people more knowledgeable than I suggested a regular scatter plot. Using boxplot is sensible only when you have too many points to show the (approximate) distribution. Just a little something to think about.

On your annotation note, you could perhaps try annotate_custom.

Cheers,
Roman
